def initialize_muscles_exercises(apps, schema_editor):
    with open('exercises.json', 'r') as file:
        data = json.load(file)

        Musc = apps.get_model("lzwrkts", "Muscles")
        Ex = apps.get_model("lzwrkts, Exercise")

        for item in data:
            if(not Musc.objects.exists() or not Musc.objects.filter(id=item['primaryMuscles']).exists()):
                name = item['primaryMuscles']
                group = None
                if(name == 'hamstrings' or name == 'glutes' or name ==  'calves' or name == 'quadriceps'): 
                    # group = Group.objects.get(name='legs')
                    group = 'legs'
                elif(item['force'] == 'pull' or item['force'] == 'push'):
                    #group = Group.objects.get(name=item['force'])
                    group = item['force']
                Musc.objects.create(name = name, exercise_group = group)
            if(not Ex.objects.exists() or not Ex.objects.filter(name=item['name']).exists()):
                name = item['name']
                category = item['category']
                equipment = item['equipment']
                primary_muscle = Musc.objects.get(name=item['primaryMuscles'][0])
                instructions = item['instructions']
                level = item['level']
                image1_path = item['images'][0]
                image2_path = item['images'][1]

                Ex.objects.create(name = name, category = category, equipment = equipment, primary_muscle = primary_muscle, 
                                  instructions = instructions, level = level, image1_path = image1_path, image2_path = image2_path)
